# Waylock guides

Waylock is an Android route-planning app. Waylock is in internal testing. Public installation is not available yet. Device checks on the route controls remain open, so these guides describe planned controls rather than steps you can rely on.


## Get Waylock

- [All apps](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/apps): every released surface of Waylock.
- [Website](https://waylock.aoneahsan.com)

## Start here
- [Guide overview](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/)
- [Release status](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/release-status)
- [Route controls](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/route-controls)
- [Account and data](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/account-and-data)
- [Moving from another app](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/compare)
- [Developers](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers)

## Developers
- [Waylock for developers](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers): what a script, an assistant or a server can reach in a person's own Waylock account, and each plan's limits. Family and plan data are read only; there is no calendar feed.
- [Access keys](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers/access-keys): `wl_pat_` keys with Read, Change and Delete ticks per part.
- [The API](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers/api): base URL https://tmaycqghtpbonstmonjd.supabase.co/functions/v1/api/v1, errors, cursor pages, rate limits and every resource.
- [Assistants](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers/assistants): MCP at https://tmaycqghtpbonstmonjd.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp for Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Cursor. An assistant's delete waits for the person's confirmation.
- [Webhooks](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers/webhooks): events, sample payloads and Standard Webhooks signature checks in Node and Python.
- [Two-step sign-in](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers/two-step-sign-in): setup, recovery codes, seven-day remembered browser or phone.
- [Developer changelog](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/developers/changelog)
- [OpenAPI document](https://tmaycqghtpbonstmonjd.supabase.co/functions/v1/api/v1/openapi.json)

## White-label & licensing
- [Running Waylock under your own brand](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/white-label): a hosted, branded licence, or a source buyout that carries a 7% royalty on the gross revenue Waylock earns, for as long as it earns. Licences are paid by Wise bank transfer.
- [What is delivered](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/white-label/delivery)
- [From payment to launch](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/white-label/setup)
- [Updates and renewals](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/white-label/updates)
- [Checking a licence](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/white-label/verify)
- [Questions buyers ask](https://waylock-docs.aoneahsan.com/guide/white-label/faq)
- Prices: [licence price](https://waylock.aoneahsan.com/white-label/pricing), [buyout](https://waylock.aoneahsan.com/white-label/buyout), [verify a licence](https://waylock.aoneahsan.com/verify-license)
